discovered.author: @AnthropicAI
discovered.content: New research on constitutional AI and value alignment. Our latest work shows promise in scaling oversight mechanisms for advanced AI systems.

discovered.author: @eliezeryudkowsky
discovered.content: The fundamental problem with AGI alignment isn't technical difficulty—it's that most proposed solutions don't actually solve the core problem of aligning superhuman intelligence.

discovered.author: @sama
discovered.content: Building AGI that genuinely cares about human values is the defining challenge of our time. Technical capability is advancing faster than our ability to ensure alignment.

discovered.author: @paulg
discovered.content: Watching the AI alignment debate reminds me of watching the early internet debates. The people who understand the technical details are often the most worried.

discovered.author: @karpathy
discovered.content: Alignment tax is real: making AI systems safer and more aligned often makes them less capable in the short term. This creates a dangerous race dynamic.
